style: Original 3D black comedy, deadpan slapstick, vivid saturated colors, high contrast, original character design
subject: ONE old grey goose: white head feathers, round glasses on a chain, big bright cobalt-blue vest; hugs a bright orange desk box (mug, cactus, photo frame), cane on it. Deadpan, wings pressed, never flies.
second_characters: ONE grinning mole boss, purple suit, 40th-floor window. THREE clerks, orange ties: rabbit with a briefcase, ferret, beaver.
props: Shovel: yellow handle, shiny blade, huge scarlet bow; the mole's, then stuck by the goose. Rack of identical bowed shovels under the mole's sill, only scarlet bows show. Box, cane: goose's. Briefcase: rabbit's.
environment: Bright TURQUOISE glass tower, open 40th-floor window; sunny-yellow tile plaza, revolving glass door at the base.
lighting: Bright noon sun; warm key on the goose's face, amber rim left, magenta rim right. Cobalt vest, orange box, scarlet bows, yellow handle vivid against turquoise glass and yellow tiles, wide and close.

light_events.event: sun flashes on the falling blade

motion_rule: camera always moving in sharp 0.3-0.8 s moves from frame one, each ending on the gag; goose fills half the frame, except the close-up beats

audio.delivery: Goose alone, dry deadpan adult voice, beak free while speaking

timeline.a: From the first frame: the goose dangles outside the 40th-floor window; the mole leans out pumping his wing in a farewell handshake; scarlet bows peek over the sill.
timeline.c: soars up the glass into the handshake, close-up

timeline.a: The mole opens his paw and waves bye; the goose drops straight down, box hugged.
timeline.c: tumbles over the sill, waving paw in foreground

timeline.a: Falling upright down the turquoise facade, he straightens his glasses with a wingtip.
The cactus hops out; he snaps it in his beak, drops it back.
He hits the yellow tiles and sinks neck-deep, cracks ringing his neck; the box lands upright beside him.
Rabbit, ferret, beaver hurry into the revolving door, heads turned to him with pity; the rabbit's briefcase knocks his glasses askew; he hisses, then fixes them.
timeline.c: arcs low round his head, legs in foreground

timeline.a: He sets the mug and photo frame on the hole's edge like a desk.
timeline.c: skims the tiles to the mug

timeline.a: Up top the mole aims and throws the bowed shovel down like a spear; the goose jerks his head up.
timeline.c: soars up the facade to the throw

timeline.a: At 8.00 the falling shovel stabs blade-first into the tiles a finger from his neck, handle quivering; he does not blink.
timeline.c: hurls itself behind the blade, crashes in at his neck, close-up

timeline.a: He straightens the stuck shovel's bow with a wingtip, nods once, beak free.
At the window the mole lifts the next bowed shovel off the rack, looking down at the clerks. Last frame: new scarlet bow in the mole's paw, a row of bows behind, clerks below.
timeline.c: shoots up the facade into the new bow, close-up

negative_prompt: subtitles, captions, watermark, text overlay, English speech, foreign accent, slow speech, static camera, locked-off shots, a flat medium shot, muted colors, dark scene, duplicate props, extra limbs, extra characters beyond those listed, character changing appearance mid-shot, blood, humans
